subject: E-Commerce
title: Sidewalk Robots
description: A short lesson to help you apply Sidewalk Robots.

hook.text: Starship Technologies' sidewalk robots have completed 6 M deliveries. They look like coolers on wheels rolling at 4 mph.

buildup.text: Delivery robots navigate sidewalks using cameras and sensors. They carry food, groceries, and small packages.

discovery.text: College campuses are the perfect testbed. George Mason, Purdue, and dozens of universities use Starship robots daily.

twist.text: Sidewalk robots struggle in cities: crowds, construction, stairs, and weather derail them.

climax.text: Delivery robots are real and working—but only in specific, controlled environments. Scaling to cities remains unsolved.

punchline.text: 6 million deliveries at 4 mph. Sidewalk robots work on campuses but can't.

quiz.question: Where do delivery robots work most effectively?
options: Controlled environments like college campuses with predictable layouts
